text:
Maya Patel: quick check on the launch day flow — we still have gaps: canonical strategy for the benchmark report excerpt on the webinar page, internal link anchors from product blog posts, and a redirects safety net in case the old campaign hub is live. I want clear owners.
Ethan Ruiz: I can take canonical + excerpt length. proposal: canonical on webinar -> benchmark report but include a 300-500 word excerpt on the webinar page so we get SERP context. that helps with featured snippets.
Nina Gomez: internal linking plan: we'll add contextual links from "/blog/inference-benchmarks" and the model guide. suggest using natural anchors: "benchmarks", "latency comparison", "cost breakdown". avoid over-optimizing exact-match anchors.
Samir Khan: on-page meta: will set meta-title to "Inference cost benchmark webinar | Redwood Inference" and meta-desc referencing the report & CTA. for H1 we prefer the keyword "inference cost benchmark" and keep brand in the title tag as suffix.
Leo Chen: redirects: I scanned legacy campaign urls. recommending the following mapping (we'll implement 302 for 5 days then 301):
```
/launch/old-bench -> /webinar/inference-benchmark-2026
/campaigns/inference -> /resources/benchmarks
/old-register -> /webinar/register?src=campaign
```
I'll open the PR and include health-checks.
WebhookBot: webhook test sent to /webhooks/marketing at 2026-04-08T14:22Z, status 200 for form slug /forms/webinar-v3. retries disabled => Ops, enable retry on 5xx.
Maya Patel: CTA mapping: primary CTA on page should be "Register" (form /forms/webinar-v3). secondary CTA: "Read benchmark" linking to canonical. Priya from SDR to confirm mapping for utm_campaign=bench-2026 -> SDR-team-4.
Ethan Ruiz: canonical snippet I'll use: ```<link rel="canonical" href="https://redwood.ai/reports/inference-benchmark-2026" />``` and add meta name robots for sections we don't want indexed.
Nina Gomez: schema: will add Event + Article + FAQ as JSON-LD. small note: keep the FAQ Qs distinct from the report excerpt to avoid duplication penalties.
Samir Khan: uploaded final keyword buckets to https://go.redwood/seo/179999-keywords-v2. target hero keyword: "inference cost benchmark"; supporting: "LLM inference cost comparison", "GPU inference latency".
Leo Chen: PR: https://go.redwood/dev/redirects/PR-548. left comment: need green on webhook retry config and canonical URL before we flip the 301.
Maya Patel: schedule: staging push 2026-04-10 09:00 PST. checklists: schema validator pass, canonical link present, internal link anchors added, redirects in PR. sync tomorrow 9am.
Ethan Ruiz: I'll post the canonical & excerpt in the doc now.
Nina Gomez: I'll drop the link map into the shared sheet and flag pages with missing anchors.
Samir Khan: will QA meta + OG tags after Jordan's copy updates.
Maya Patel: thanks team. small ask: keep the excerpt under 450 words and include a clear link "Read the full benchmark" to the report.
